rules_close_AB.R1_orientation_at_5_5_not_reproduced: If the new diagonal (5,5) mean K_AB is within 5% of the new horizontal (5,5) mean, the round-1 diagonal deficit (6.5%) is treated as a fluctuation.
rules_close_AB.R2_orientation_at_5_5_reproduced: If the new diagonal (5,5) mean K_AB is again at least 5% below the new horizontal mean, the diagonal deficit is treated as real at (5,5) and not at (3,3); close-AB is held and orientation is scoped to horizontal only.
rules_close_AB.R3_publication: Publish close-AB only if the pre-registered rule (SE <= 3%, horizontal vs diagonal within 5%, no run more than 10% from the pooled mean) passes on all 28 runs (rounds 1 and 3 plus round 2 at (3,3)). Note: run 2026-11-22/r1/lab-a/005 (K_AB 4.86) is 11% below the 20-run pooled mean; it is not excluded post hoc. If it still fails (iii) on 28 runs, close-AB stays held.

rules_close_AC_pilot.P1: Pilot reports K_AC and K_CA with per-run scatter. Claim requires a later orientation control within 5% and a pass of the same SE and max-deviation rules as close-AB.
